title: Waterfront development
titleCn: 海滨旧港改造开发项目介绍

paragraphs.text: First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to sixteen.
Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to sixteen.

Well, thank you all for coming along to this talk about our new waterfront development. The council has developed the old boat harbor to provide a new area of leisure facilities right here on the city's waterfront, and we want to encourage local people to visit the new development.

Okay, I'll start with some background. Long before the harbor was built, the first building on the site was put up by Sir Michael Grayson. He'd been working in Asia for a time, and when he came home, he began developing the city along this part of the coast.

However, there was a problem with the site. Because the land was low-lying, whenever there was a storm, large waves would break on the shore, which could be destructive. So Grayson built a wall along the beach to protect the land behind it, and that solved the problem.

Then, in nineteen fifteen, the land here became more valuable. Some companies were not doing very well financially, so the government wanted to increase local business activity, and they did this by constructing a better road connecting this site to the city center. That had an important impact, and later on, over the following years, it led to additional migration to this part of the country.

One obvious change came in the nineteen twenties when the first boat harbor was built here. The water was too shallow for large ocean liners carrying people, so these continued to use the main wharf further south.
But the smaller boats that went out each day to catch snapper, tuna, and other species to feed the city started to use this as their port.
Defense Force ships, of course, already had their own base further up the coast.

Then, in the nineteen thirties, warehouses were built around the harbor, and it was made deeper. That's because international trade was increasing. It's true that some parts of the economy, like sheep farming, were in decline, but forestry was a major growth sector.
The timber was brought here by train, kept in the new buildings, then shipped to foreign countries.

So, why do we need this latest redevelopment? Well, over the years, the harbor had become run-down. They talked about doing something for ten years before anything actually happened. Finally, the project started when a team of designers began work, and a consultation plan was drawn up. And now, fourteen years after the project started, the new waterfront area is open to the public. We hope that nothing will need to be done now for another twenty-five years, when the harbor wall will need upgrading.

I have to say, some parts of the redevelopment were quite difficult. We were lucky with the steamship because it had already been restored. What we really wanted were some traditional trams, so we bought some from another city. But it turned out to be a long process, and they needed a lot of modification for our system, the hardest thing we had to do.
We decided against renovating the old bridge and instead replaced it with a modern one, which was very simple in comparison.
Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions seventeen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions seventeen to twenty.

Okay, so now I'll just tell you about a few of the features of the new development. Um, so if you look at your maps, you'll see we're here, where it says South Gate, near the bottom of the map. So first, the playground. From South Gate, walk north until you come to the lifting bridge. Cross the bridge to the area we call North Wharf, and the playground is at the eastern end there, right beside the water.

So, the open-air cinema. They show movies on a big outdoor screen, after dark, of course. It's a lot of fun, and it's up on North Wharf. Look in the northwest corner. It's a circular enclosure. You can't miss it.
Now, we've also built a small aquarium that's full of local species of fish. It's close to South Gate. Find Pier One, and it's right down at the end of that.
Now, the Maritime Museum is well worth a visit. It's the only one of its sort in the country.

From South Gate, you go... Well, actually, you can go two ways. Either go around the boat harbor or go over the lifting bridge, and it's the long, thin building that runs right along the north side of the boat harbor.
Okay, well, that's the end of my talk, but if you have any...
That is the end of Part Two. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers to Part Two.
